# Owned scoped capture before superclass fixture

A variadic generic child creates an exact raw callback from its original
String array and Class<T> token before calling a parent with a complete
Comparator-super-T parameter. Source and SDK-parent profiles compile every
recovered unit and compare original entries, fields, metadata and Exceptions.
Frozen callers run 144 fresh JVM cases twice through four entry routes. They
observe capture and parent evaluation order, exact type/array/callback identity,
null/empty arrays, mutations, fresh objects, partial final fields, constructor
counts and exact capture/parent/late callback failures. Six wrong programs and
six Code-preserving Signature controls guard scope and ABI. Only owned fixture
code executes. Use JDK 25 for recovered prologues and release 8 for originals.
